title: Implement Helm Integration
description: Implement Helm integration: List Charts from repositories, List Releases, Install/Upgrade/Uninstall charts.
notes: Done: read-only Helm releases + chart catalog via helm CLI with capability detection. Remaining: install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall and values view.

title: Implement Config Section
description: Implement pages and backend logic for Config resources: ConfigMaps, Secrets, Resource Quotas, Limit Ranges, HPA, PDBs, Priority Classes, Runtime Classes, Leases. Ensure secret values are masked by default.
notes: Done: ConfigMaps, Secrets, ResourceQuotas, LimitRanges, HPA, PDB (list/YAML edit/delete). Remaining: PriorityClasses, RuntimeClasses, Leases pages; secret value masking in a dedicated detail view.

title: Implement Network Section
description: Implement pages and backend logic for Network resources: Services, Endpoints, Ingresses, Network Policies, Port Forwarding. Include visual status for services and endpoints.
notes: Done: Services, Endpoints, Ingresses, NetworkPolicies (list/YAML edit/delete). Remaining: port forwarding, service/endpoint-specific columns and status visuals.

title: Implement App Branding and Logo
description: Create application logo (SVG) and generate app icons for all platforms using `tauri icon`. Update Sidebar to use the new logo.
close_reason: Completed logo creation and icon generation.

title: Implement Access Control Section
description: Implement pages and backend logic for Access Control: Service Accounts, Roles, Cluster Roles, Role Bindings. visualize permissions if possible.
close_reason: ServiceAccounts, Roles, ClusterRoles, RoleBindings, ClusterRoleBindings implemented with YAML edit/delete.

title: Rebrand to Kore
description: Rebrand from RustyLens to Kore (Kubernetes Orchestration and Resource Explorer). Update all branding, color scheme to Kubernetes blue, create new logo (K8s septagon with spyglass), and regenerate all app icons.
close_reason: Completed full rebrand to Kore with new logo and Kubernetes blue theme.

title: Implement Custom Resources Section
description: Implement Custom Resource Definitions (CRD) browser. List CRDs and allow viewing/editing instances of custom resources.
notes: Done: CRD list/YAML edit/delete. Remaining: browse/edit instances of a CRD and show schema/versions.

title: Implement Nodes & Cluster Overview
description: Implement Nodes list view with metrics (CPU/Memory usage) if available. Show detailed node status and conditions.
close_reason: Nodes list with detail drawer shipped in 0.2.0; live CPU/memory usage via metrics.k8s.io (cluster_get_node_usage) with graceful fallback added.

title: Implement Storage Section
description: Implement pages and backend logic for Storage resources: PVCs, PVs, Storage Classes. Show capacity and usage where possible.
close_reason: PVC, PV, StorageClass list/detail/YAML edit/delete implemented via WorkloadList.

title: Implement Initial MVP: Pods, Theming, and Multi-Cluster
description: Implement the core application shell, including semantic theming (Rusty, Dracula, etc.), multi-cluster management (backend config & sidebar), and the Pods view with real-time updates and batch actions.

title: Implement Events and Namespaces Pages
description: Implement cluster-wide Events viewer and Namespaces management (Create/Delete namespaces).
close_reason: Events viewer shipped in 0.2.0; namespace create (cluster_create_namespace) and delete now both available from the Namespaces page.

title: Implement Workloads Section
description: Implement pages and backend logic for Workload resources: Deployments, DaemonSets, StatefulSets, ReplicaSets, Jobs, CronJobs. Ensure they support filtering by namespace and context.
close_reason: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ReplicaSets, Jobs, CronJobs all implemented with namespace filtering, YAML edit, scale/restart, and detail drawers for Deployments and StatefulSets.

title: Pod exec / interactive shell
description: Add an interactive terminal tab in the bottom drawer that execs into a pod container (kube exec attach over websocket). The old 'Open Shell' stub was removed from the pods page until this exists.

title: Port forwarding
description: Add port-forward support for Services and Pods (start/stop, list active forwards) surfaced from the Network section.

title: Resource-specific columns in WorkloadList
description: WorkloadList shows the same name/namespace/status/images/age columns for all 25+ kinds. Add per-kind columns (Service ClusterIP/ports, PVC capacity, RoleBinding subjects, CRD group/versions, HPA min/max/current, etc.).

title: Remove ~/.rustylens data-dir migration after a few releases
description: After a couple of releases, remove the legacy ~/.rustylens -> ~/.kore migration in config::migrate_legacy_app_dir and ClusterManager::migrate_config_paths.
